summary.goal: Provide a 'mission control' experience for humans overseeing multiple planning agents working in parallel. Enable ambient awareness of agent activity, focused interaction when decisions are needed, and intelligent question queuing to prevent overwhelm.

acceptance_criteria.description: Permanent bottom status bar is visible across all views
Agent avatars show real-time state (working, waiting, idle, error)
Chat bubbles pop up for @user questions, one at a time
Questions queue by priority (blocking > preference > confirmation)
User answers are stored as trajectory events
Agents can query user trajectory before asking questions
User preference model builds over time from decisions

out_of_scope: Full trajectory persistence service (use existing relay trajectories)
Cross-plan global preferences (plan-scoped only for v1)
